title: AC1024 associative value-dependency closure
scope: Resolve source-matched ACDBASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY dep_on targets, direct owner routes, network membership, persistent-reactor backlinks, and reciprocal readdep/node chains for three AC1024 witnesses. The audit preserves field labels and checks graph consistency without assigning additional application meaning.

independentReader.name: LibreDWG dwgread
independentReader.sourceFields: /Users/dli/dev/libredwg/include/dwg.h Dwg_Object_ASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY embeds Dwg_Object_ASSOCDEPENDENCY fields; the peer JSON exposes dep_on, readdep, node, ownerhandle, and reactor references.
independentReader.projectionMethod: Index LibreDWG OBJECTS by absolute handle. For each ASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY, resolve dep_on to ASSOCVARIABLE, locate its owner as either an ASSOC2DCONSTRAINTGROUP or ASSOCVARIABLE, compare their owning network, require the target variable's reactor list to contain the dependency once, and check every non-null readdep/node target for type, reciprocal edge, same dep_on variable, and same network.
independentReader.limitation: LibreDWG's independent source projection corroborates these profiles only; it does not qualify local DXF serialization or consumer semantics.

implementation.behavior: The bounded AC1024 audit indexes action and constraint-group list membership once, then resolves every value dependency's dep_on target, direct group-or-variable owner route, shared network, and single target reactor backlink. Non-null readdep/node links must resolve to another complete value dependency with the same dep_on variable and network and the reciprocal opposite link. Unknown owner/target types, duplicate memberships, missing edges, or exceeded work bounds leave closure false.
